title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Term Retention Schedule for Overlap Credits
content:
| Renewal entries the certificate carries | Kept by Tidemark from the overlap credit |
|---|---|
| None | 50 dollars |
| Exactly one | 25 dollars |
| Two or more | Nothing |

**Term retention — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, overlap schedule.** When a certificate ends on confirmed borrower coverage, Tidemark keeps, without taking the overlap credit below zero, 50 dollars of it when the certificate carries no renewal entry, 25 dollars when it carries exactly one renewal entry, and nothing when it carries two or more.

The amount kept is taken off the overlap credit only once every amount added to the credit has been added; it never takes the credit below zero. The count is of renewal entries on that certificate number.
